messages:
Jenni (Head of GTM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — throwing a live thread for any sticky Qs on sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partner updates. TL;DR: Dedicated launch + partner integrations are top priorities. Drop asks and we'll surface to execs. cc @Maya @Sanjay

Sanjay (VP Sales): For the top 10 pipeline accounts, do we have partner-led plays? Need list + owners so reps can prioritize. Maria can you pull?

Maria (Sales Ops): On it, pulling CRM report now. Will post CSV link when done.

Chris (Partnerships): We're running 3 co-sell pilots. Need clarity on revenue attribution and SDR handoff. Also when do we get joint marketing assets?

Maya (CEO): Agree we need clear defaults for attribution. Suggest 60/40 rev split for co-sell pilots unless legal flags. Marketing assets: aim for first drafts by 4/10.

Alex (Product): Quick product note: Dedicated launch plan still on track. Main risk is quant perf on a700 GPUs — eng-runtime is tuning kernels. Canary ETA next week.

Sanjay (VP Sales): For demos, recommended model variant? Latency-sensitive customers need a lighter config.

Jenni (Head of GTM): Recommendation: use `redwood-prod-v2-llama-quant` for demos (lower latency), and `redwood-high-fidelity` for POC/benchmarks where quality matters. Docs in #docs/GTM-updates.

Alex (Product): Rollout policy snippet we're following:
```
canary: 5% traffic
monitor: latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost
rollback: auto if error-rate > 1% or p95 latency regresses > 30%
```

DevRel Bot: Posted demo templates + quick snippet library: https://redwood.internal/docs/demo-templates 

Chris (Partnerships): Can we schedule a 30m partner enablement call next Tue? @Sanjay @Jenni — want to sync on co-sell plays + one-pager assets.

Jenni (Head of GTM): Yes, I'll propose 3 time slots.

Maria (Sales Ops): Report uploaded: https://s3.internal/reports/top10_pipeline.csv — includes owner column + partner flags.

Sanjay (VP Sales): Thanks Maria — will review and assign plays by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (CEO): Exec ask: we need a short analysis on unit economics for Dedicated vs Hosted. Ops/Prod to produce delta by EOW so we can share with finance.

Alex (Product): I'll run perf/cost sims and pull trace data — expect initial numbers in ~3 days. Need authorization to access some billing logs.

Jenni (Head of GTM): Action items recap: Maria — owners/report (done). Alex — perf sims (ETA 3 days). Chris — schedule partner enablement (ETA 2 days). Sanjay — assign plays (ETA EOD tomorrow). Anyone who needs to be added to the call ping me. :thumbsup:

AllHands Bot: Summary posted to #all-hands/notes: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/2040012345/summary
